The 334b531…→bbc4779… delta changed release/package identity and bounded lifecycle copy but did not change Care's Glaze implementation, canonical icon, UI contract, focus/accessibility contract files, or runtime UI acceptance harness. Exact 0.1.0 automated qualification and representative Zorin acceptance passed. The bridge does not fabricate a second human review, does not independently grant overall Care production eligibility, and does not authorize Stable product promotion.
